title: Çiçek Tutulması
author: Nurdan Bağrıaçık
description: Oksa and Mira are two flowers with different sleeping times: one is awake during the day while the other sleeps, so they cannot see each other. The curious forest owl, Mr. Puhu, searches for a solution and consults the Wise Owl. When the animals learn that a total solar eclipse could bring the two flowers together, they are amazed.
